blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult. We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU .
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 随着视频捕捉移动到手持和边缘设备,相机摇晃产生的运动模糊已经成为一种普遍的退化,降低了知觉质量并伤害了下游的视觉任务. 最强的去blurring网络恢复了令人印象深刻的细节,然而它们仍然在计算上沉重而极其复杂,因此其质量要付出消费者硬件无法实时支付的代价. 修复质量与设备上速度之间的这一差距正是使实时分解困难的原因. 我们开发并实施了TSRN-RTVD,这是一个高效的视频分解系统,在曝光时明确重建了相机底部轨迹,并使用所回收的运动来引导修复. 这种方法将模糊的物理原因转化为驱动磨损的信号. 我们的系统运行在单一消费的GPU上,在GoPro数据集上达到30.08 dB PSNR的同时恢复了30 FPS的视频. 我们在消费设备上演示TSRN-RTVD,对模糊的输入和被破损的输出进行交互并列可视化,现场吞吐量,对回收相机轨迹进行屏幕上查看. Demo视频可在https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU查询。

blocks.en: Figure 1 . System overview of TSRN-RTVD. The method processes a streaming blurry input frame by frame, predicts camera trajectory, performs trajectory-guided recurrent fusion, and outputs deblurred frames in real time. The example is taken from a dataset that was not used for training, demonstrating generalization to real camera motion blur. TSRN-RTVD results on a real-blur dataset unseen during training.
blocks.zh: 图1. TSRN-RTVD系统概况. 该方法按帧处理流出模糊的输入框架,预测相机轨迹,进行轨迹制导的相机再生聚变,并实时输出分解相机. 这个例子取自一个没有用于训练的数据集,显示通俗化到真实相机运动模糊. TSRN-RTVD在训练期间所未见的活化数据集上得出了结果.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction and System Features
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言和系统特征

blocks.en: Motion blur is common in handheld and on-board video, where camera shake and fast motion degrade both visual quality and downstream perception. Efficient deblurring techniques are therefore needed to overcome blur and restore sharp videos. Real-time deblurring is especially important for live preview, video streaming, teleoperation, tracking, and detection, where restored frames must be produced as the video arrives. Existing video deblurring methods achieve strong quality on benchmarks such as DVD ( Su et al., 2017 ) and GoPro ( Nah et al., 2017 ) , but many high-quality systems rely on dense optical flow, deformable alignment, recurrent propagation, or long temporal contexts ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Chan et al., 2022 ; Pan et al., 2023 ) . These components are effective for offline restoration, but they increase computation and latency in an interactive real-time system. Moreover, due to computational complexity of existing methods, they cannot be run on consumer devices such as phones or laptops, limiting their application.
blocks.zh: 运动模糊常见于手持相机和机上视频,相机摇动和快动会同时降低视觉质量和下游感知. 因此,需要高效的分解技术来克服模糊并恢复锋利的视频。 实时分解对于现场预览、视频流、远程操作、跟踪和检测尤为重要,在视频到达时必须制作恢复的帧。 现有视频分解方法在DVD(Su等,2017年)和GoPro(Nah等,2017年)等基准上实现了强质量,但许多高品质系统依赖于密集的光学流,可变的对接,反复传播,或长时间的时事背景(Wang等,2019;Chan等,2022;Pan等,2023年). 这些组件对于离线修复是有效的,但它们在交互式实时系统中增加了计算和耐用性. 此外,由于现有方法的计算复杂性,它们不能运行在电话或笔记本电脑等消费设备上,限制了它们的应用.

blocks.en: On the other hand, real-time video deblurring methods do exist ( Nah et al., 2019 ; Son et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2021 ) , leveraging intra-frame iterations, multi-patch hierarchy, and spatio-temporal attention. They typically operate in the range of 40–100 FPS, but their restoration quality remains below that of offline methods. This leaves an underexplored region on the speed–quality Pareto frontier, where a different design trade-off is needed. This region is where near-offline restoration quality has to be delivered within a strict per-frame budget, and it motivates the design we describe next.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,确实存在实时视频分解方法(Nah等,2019;Son等,2022;Deng等,2021),利用了帧内分解,多分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分解. 它们通常在40-100个FPS范围内运行,但其还原质量仍然低于离线方法. 这使得在速度-质量-帕雷托边界上的地区探索不足,需要不同的设计取舍。 这一地区的近线恢复质量必须在严格的预算范围内交付,它激励了我们下面描述的设计。

blocks.en: We present TSRN-RTVD, a Trajectory-Shift Recurrent Network for Real-Time Video Deblurring system. This system restores 720 720 p video at 30 30 FPS on Apple Silicon M5 using a short three-frame window with one-frame look-ahead. Instead of estimating the dense optical flow between blurry frames or its representations, TSRN-RTVD uses a compact trajectory signal that approximates the dominant camera-induced motion. Unlike prior real-time designs that spend their compute budget on intra-frame iterations or attention, TSRN-RTVD spends it on explicit motion, which keeps alignment nearly free and leaves capacity for the fusion and reconstruction stages that actually drive quality.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TSRN-RTVD,即实时视频Deblurring系统的Traphory-Shift经常网络。 这个系统在苹果硅M5上的30 FPS上恢复了720 720 p的视频,使用一帧外观-ahead的短三帧窗口. TSRN-RTVD没有估计模糊相框之间的密集光学流或它的表示,而是使用一个紧凑的轨迹信号来近似于主相机引起的运动. 与之前的实时设计将计算预算花在了帧内迭代上或注意力上不同,TSRN-RTVD将其花在了明确的运动上,这使得对齐几乎自由并留下了实际驱动质量的聚变与重建阶段的能力.

blocks.en: Figure 2 . Speed–quality trade-off on GoPro. TSRN-RTVD operates in the real-time regime and lies on the Pareto frontier between faster low-quality and slower high-quality methods. Scatter plot of PSNR versus FPS for GoPro video deblurring methods.
blocks.zh: 图2 速度-在GoPro上的质量取舍。 TSRN-RTVD在实时系统中运行,位于Pareto边界,在更快的低质量和较慢的高质量方法之间。 PSNR对FPS的散片情节为GoPro视频去blurring方法.

blocks.en: 2. System Overview
blocks.zh: 2. 系统概况

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the TSRN-RTVD pipeline. The system receives a blurry video stream and processes it with a one-frame look-ahead. For each output frame, it uses a three-frame window together with predicted trajectories between neighboring frames. The output is a restored center frame.
blocks.zh: 图1显示的是TSRN-RTVD输油管. 系统接收了模糊的视频流,并以一帧外观-ahead处理. 对于每个输出帧,它使用一个三帧窗口,加上相邻帧之间的预测轨迹. 输出为已还原的中心框架.

blocks.en: Trajectory prediction. The trajectory represents the projection of the motion of the camera onto the image plane. In practice, it is a compact displacement signal that describes the dominant shift of image content between neighboring frames. During inference, TSRN-RTVD obtains this signal from a lightweight trajectory-prediction network applied directly to the input video.
blocks.zh: 轨迹预测. 轨迹代表相机运动向图像平面的投影. 实际上,这是一种紧凑的迁移信号,它描述了相邻框架之间图像内容的主要转变. 在推论期间,TSRN-RTVD从直接应用于输入视频的轻量级轨迹预测网络得到这个信号.

blocks.en: Trajectory-guided alignment. The deblurring network is a compact recurrent residual model operating mostly in low-resolution feature space. A shared encoder extracts features from the current and neighboring blurry frames. The predicted trajectory is then used to shift neighboring-frame features and the recurrent state toward the current frame. This trajectory-guided shift provides a cheap approximation of temporal alignment without dense optical flow, cost volumes, or deformable convolution.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-导线对接. 分解网络是一种紧凑的经常性残余模型,主要在低分辨率地物空间运作. 一个共享的编码器从当前和相邻的模糊相框中提取出特征. 然后利用所预测的轨迹将相邻框架的特征和经常状态转向目前的框架。 这种由轨迹制导的转向提供了不密集光学流量,成本量,或可变形的相位相位相位的廉价近似.

blocks.en: Temporal fusion and reconstruction. The aligned temporal features, current-frame features, and motion embeddings are fused by convolutional blocks. Rather than imposing a hand-crafted memory rule, the network learns from these inputs how much past and neighboring information to use under different motion patterns. The decoder predicts a residual image which is added to the blurry input frame to produce the restored output.
blocks.zh: 时间聚变与重建. 对齐的时间特征、当前框架特征和运动嵌入由演化区块相接而成。 网络不但没有强制实行手工制作的内存规则,反而从这些投入中学习到在不同运动模式下可以使用多少过去和相邻的信息. 解码器预测一个被添加到模糊输入框中的剩余图像,以产生已恢复的输出.

blocks.en: Real-time processing. The system is implemented as a streaming pipeline. Encoded features are cached and reused across neighboring windows, so each new frame is encoded once.
blocks.zh: 实时处理. 该系统作为流管实施. 被编码的特性被缓存并被再用到相邻的窗口之间,因此每个新框架都会被编码一次.

blocks.en: 3. Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 3. 实验结果

blocks.en: We evaluate TSRN-RTVD on the GoPro benchmark ( Nah et al., 2017 ) , the standard dataset for dynamic-scene motion deblurring. We report restoration quality with PSNR and measure throughput in frames per second. All experiments run at 1280 × 720 1280{\times}720 resolution, which is one of the most common formats for handheld and streaming video, on a single consumer GPU RTX 2080 Ti. Following MIMO-UNet ( Cho et al., 2021 ) , we place a CUDA synchronization barrier around each forward pass, so the measured latency reflects the full GPU workload instead of asynchronous kernel launches.
blocks.zh: 我们在GoPro基准(Nah等,2017年)上评价了TSRN-RTVD,即动态-场地运动分解的标准数据集. 我们用PSNR报告恢复质量,并测量每秒帧的吞吐量。 所有实验均以1280×720 1280\times}720分辨率运行,这是手持相机和相机相机相机视频最常见的格式之一,在一个单一的消费者GPU RTX 2080 Ti上. 继MIMO-UNet(Cho等,2021)之后,我们在每个前行通道上设置了CUDA同步屏障,因此所测量的延迟反映了GPU的全部工作量而不是同步内核发射.

blocks.en: Figure 2 reports the speed–quality trade-off against streaming and real-time-oriented baselines. We set 25 25 FPS as the real-time threshold and compare the methods that produce restored frames as the stream arrives. TSRN-RTVD reaches 30.08 30.08 dB PSNR while running at 30 30 FPS, which places it on the Pareto frontier inside the real-time regime. TSRN-RTVD fills the previously underexplored region of the frontier and combines real-time speed with restoration quality close to that of slower offline systems.
blocks.zh: 图2报告了速度-质量与流线和实时导向基线之间的取舍。 我们设定了25个25个FPS作为实时阈值,并比较了在流出后产生还原帧的方法. TSRN-RTVD在运行30个FPS时达到30.08分贝PSNR,将其放入实时政权内的帕雷托边境. TSRN-RTVD填充了之前开发不足的边疆地区,并结合了实时速度和修复质量接近较慢的离线系统.

blocks.en: 4. System Demonstration
blocks.zh: 4. 系统演示

blocks.en: A visitor connects a phone or a webcam to a laptop with a low-end GPU and points it at a scene. The system reads the live stream, runs the full trajectory-shift recurrent pipeline frame by frame, and renders the restored video with no perceptible delay. The interface shows the blurry input and the deblurred output side by side, so visitors compare restoration quality directly on their own footage. We invite visitors to shake the camera or move it quickly, which produces real handheld motion blur, and the system removes it on the fly. The interface also reports live FPS so visitors confirm that processing stays in the real-time regime on consumer hardware.
blocks.zh: 访客将手机或网络相机与带有低端GPU的笔记本电脑相接,并在一幕中指向. 系统读取了活流,按帧运行了整个轨迹相变的经常性管框,使被恢复的视频没有任何可察觉的延迟. 界面同时显示模糊的输入和被分解的输出,因此访客直接在自己的镜头上比较修复质量. 我们邀请访客摇动相机或快速移动相机,这会产生真正的手持运动模糊,系统会将其从苍蝇上取出. 界面还报告FPS现场直播,因此访问者确认处理方式停留在消费硬件的实时系统中.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en: We presented TSRN-RTVD, a real-time trajectory-guided video deblurring system that restores 720 720 p video at 30 30 FPS with a one-frame look-ahead. The system combines lightweight trajectory prediction with compact recurrent restoration, using image-plane camera-motion shifts to align temporal features without dense optical flow. This design keeps the pipeline simple, low-latency, and suitable for interactive video applications.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了TSRN-RTVD,一个实时的轨迹制导视频分解系统,在30 FPS恢复了720 720 p的视频,并配有一帧外观-ahead. 该系统将轻量级轨迹预测与紧凑的经常性还原相结合,使用影像-平面相机-运动相变来调和不密集光学流的时间特征. 这种设计保持了管道的简单,低纬度,并适合交互式视频应用.
